release_blockers: No paper-final VideoDPO checkpoint is released.
Official README and run.sh paths do not resolve to checked-in files.
Released VC2 config uses max_epochs=10 rather than max_steps=3000.
Released VC2 config sets dupbeta=0 and disables OmniScore pair reweighting.
Official pair.json has no score field, so the released archive cannot reproduce OmniScore reweighting.
Official metadata contains stale absolute author-machine media paths and requires a provenance-recorded rewrite.
Exact evaluation environment and generation seeds are absent.
